data.long_meaning: The name Sharunikaana is derived from the Sanskrit language and is composed of the words Shara (meaning victory or command) and Nika (meaning new) and Ana (meaning without or free from). The name Sharunikaana signifies the goddess of victory who bestows prosperity and freedom from obstacles. It is also believed to bring fertility and success in endeavors.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sharunikaana total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
